findings.title: Standard HTTPS Port Open
findings.description: The standard HTTPS port (443/tcp) is open, indicating a web server is actively listening for secure connections.
findings.recommendation: Ensure all services exposed on this port are necessary and properly secured.

findings.title: Exposed FTP Directory
findings.description: The '/ftp' directory is accessible, which is a known challenge in OWASP Juice Shop and may contain sensitive files.
findings.recommendation: Restrict access to sensitive directories or remove them if not required for public access.

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options Header
findings.description: The 'X-Frame-Options' header is missing, which could allow clickjacking attacks by embedding the site in an iframe.
findings.recommendation: Implement the 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' or 'SAMEORIGIN' header to prevent clickjacking.

findings.title: SQL Injection via Search Parameter
findings.description: The product search functionality is vulnerable to SQL injection, allowing unauthorized database access and manipulation.
findings.recommendation: Implement parameterized queries or prepared statements to prevent SQL injection vulnerabilities.

findings.title: Weak or Default Administrator Credentials
findings.description: The application uses weak or default credentials for the administrator account, allowing unauthorized access.
findings.recommendation: Enforce strong password policies and ensure default credentials are changed immediately after deployment.
findings.poc: hydra -l admin -P /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt https://juice-shop.herokuapp.com http-post-form "/rest/user/login:email=^USER^&password=^PASS^:F=Invalid email or password."

findings.title: Modern TLS Protocol Support
findings.description: The server supports modern TLS protocols (TLS 1.2, TLS 1.3) and does not offer deprecated versions like TLS 1.0 or 1.1, indicating good security posture.
findings.recommendation: Regularly review and update TLS configurations to ensure ongoing compliance with security best practices.

findings.title: Publicly Available Source Code and Documentation
findings.description: The target application's source code and extensive documentation are publicly available, which can aid attackers in identifying vulnerabilities.
findings.recommendation: While open-source, ensure production deployments are hardened and default configurations are not used.

findings.title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
findings.description: The search functionality is vulnerable to reflected XSS, allowing arbitrary client-side script execution in the user's browser.
findings.recommendation: Implement proper input sanitization and output encoding for all user-supplied data displayed on the page.

findings.title: Potential Misconfigured Cloud Storage
findings.description: Applications deployed on Heroku often utilize external cloud storage (e.g., S3) which could be misconfigured to allow public access or insecure data handling.
findings.recommendation: Review all cloud storage configurations associated with the application to ensure proper access controls and encryption are in place.

findings.title: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR)
findings.description: The API allows unauthenticated or unauthorized access to other user profiles by manipulating the user ID in the endpoint.
findings.recommendation: Implement robust authorization checks for all API endpoints that access resources based on user-supplied identifiers.

findings.title: Hardcoded API Key in Client-Side JavaScript
findings.description: A hardcoded API key was discovered within a client-side JavaScript file, which could be exploited by attackers.
findings.recommendation: Remove all sensitive data, including API keys, from client-side code and manage them securely on the server-side.

findings.title: Heroku PaaS Detected
findings.description: The application is hosted on the Heroku Platform as a Service, which provides some baseline security features but not a dedicated WAF.
findings.recommendation: Consider implementing an application-layer WAF or security solution for enhanced protection against web attacks.

kr scan https://juice-shop.herokuapp.com -w routes-large.kite && restler --target https://juice-shop.herokuapp.com
cme smb juice-shop.herokuapp.com -u '' -p '' && bloodhound-python -d juice-shop.herokuapp.com -u null -p null -c All
